name: Pre Matric Scholarship Scheme for Minorities

all_of.text: Student belongs to a notified minority community.
From 2022-23 onward, coverage is restricted to Classes IX and X.
Parents/guardians annual income does not exceed Rs. 1.00 lakh.

benefit.text: Pre-matric scholarship for minority-community students; the official scheme document describes support for school education subject to scheme conditions.

deadline.note: Official Ministry sources confirm the scheme and the IX-X restriction from 2022-23, but a current AY 2026-27 NSP timeline for this exact entry was not established in this audit.
